'''Factions & Realms''' covers the geopolitical fragmentation of Calradia in ''Realms of Dust''.  == Sovereign Micro-Realms == The historical empires and monolithic kingdoms of Calradia have fractured. In their place stand '''53 independent sovereign realms''', each governed by an autonomous noble ruling clan: * Each ruling clan is elevated to sovereign Kingdom status on Day 1. * '''Clan Tier:''' Normalized to '''Tier 3''' for all AI ruling clans. * '''Starting Influence:''' Exactly '''50 Influence''' per realm ruler for voting on early kingdom decisions and policies. * '''Starting Treasury:''' '''10,000 Denars''' in the royal clan coffers. * Each realm controls exactly one [[Starting Domains|Starting Domain]] (1 Capital, 1 Stronghold, 4 Villages).  == Noble Household & Mobilization == * '''Single Active Command:''' On Day 1, only the primary noble clan leader leads an active field party ([[Starting Forces|8 Tier-1 Recruits]]). * '''Household Residency:''' Secondary clan members (spouses, adult kin) begin stationed inside their capital as residents, preventing clans from fielding overwhelming numbers before their economy develops.  == Mercenaries & Minor Clans == Calradia's minor mercenary factions (e.g., ''Legion of the Betrayed'', ''Lake Rats'', ''Jawwal'', ''Ghilman'') remain true to their vanilla design: * They do not hold sovereign territory or fiefs. * They operate as roving sellsword companies available for contract by any realm or player with the coin to hire them.  == Cultural Distribution == Realms inherit the cultural identity, architecture, and troop lines of their native geographic territory: * '''Imperial Realms (Northern, Western, Southern):''' Distributed across the central plains and valleys. * '''Vlandian Realms:''' Clustered across the western coast and fertile riverlands. * '''Battanian Realms:''' Concentrated within the highland forests and mountain passes. * '''Sturgian Realms:''' Guarding the northern tundras, forests, and snowy coasts. * '''Aserai Realms:''' Anchoring the southern desert oases and trade routes. * '''Khuzait Realms:''' Dominating the eastern steppes and rolling plateaus.
